issues: Anti-cheat regex in test.sh uses 'sharp' without word boundaries, matching 'sharpens' in legitimate code comments - should be '\bsharp\b'
The verifier's compute_reward.py was never reached because the anti-cheat check failed first, so we cannot determine what the actual reward would have been

Several other patterns in the anti-cheat regex also lack word boundaries and could cause similar false positives (e.g., 'jimp' could match 'jimpy', 'ffmpeg' would match code discussing ffmpeg in comments)
